Boss:
Drives:
- staying in charge
- getting more power
- keeping things in order

Traits:
- stands out in a crowd
- plans ahead
- expects to be obeyed

Morality: respects rank

Relationships:
- sets the rules
- gives orders
- deals with troublemakers

In a fight: makes others take the risk and fights only when cornered; when it turns, cuts losses and leaves the crew.
